svg.aria-label: Face ID: two login attempts on a RealSense D415. A photo held up on a phone gives one flat depth plane and fails the 3D structure check. The real face, with the nose standing out from the cheeks, passes all four depth checks; ArcFace makes a 512-number embedding, pgvector finds the enrolled face above the 0.60 cosine threshold, and the auth service issues a JWT.
